topics.hook_summary: An old time favorite is pumping like crazy again: $TUT on BNB, the call Mike made public when the community did a 94X, now 638% for the month at a 65 million market cap (roughly 65x off the bottom), and one week after that 94X they did the 550X on NYX. Became clips 1 + 6.

Best meme on the Robinhood chain, without a doubt, unequivocally: What If ($IF), because it is a concept and a beautiful phrase nobody ever thought to put on a meme coin. Cooper is number two because it is a REAL dog, the office dog of Robinhood (that Toshi / Brian-Armstrong's-cat vibe). Tendies is number three because it is funny and stupid, which is exactly what gets a Robinhood app listing. Yolo four, Swappy five. Became clip 2.

Kaspa is a gem, the most beautiful thing ever when it comes to the tech. Binance published a blog article saying they are looking for community driven coins, and used exactly that argument on Neiro. They do not apply the same logic to Kaspa, because if they did, Kaspa would be listed on Binance by now: a strange catch-22. When the bulls start to run, Mike expects Kaspa to be skyrocketing. Became clips 3 + 7.

I'm not looking at the short term, what pumps in two weeks then dies and you get out before it dies: that's the degen mindset, I don't trade like that. I want the tokens retail is going to be looking at when the bull run starts up again, so I'm the one going 'holy crap, I was so freaking early'. Became clips 4 + 8.

I got that dog in me: doginme was the first dog on the base chain to be listed on Coinbase, all time high 107 million, and 400 million in a really big bull run is a 100X from here. Then the closing what-if ladder: doginme to 800 million is a 200X, and $IF listed on the Robinhood app at 5 billion is another 500X. Good times ahead. Became clip 5.
